verdict.rationale: MailerSend is a transactional email, SMS and WhatsApp API platform, not an AI agent or assistant. Acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is outside its product role. The only AI-related evidence ("Connect MailerSend directly to AI tools like Claude or Gemini") describes exposing MailerSend to AI clients, which is the server direction, so it does not make this client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
